		isLinked: Boolean = if CurrentOrderProduct.Supplier = supplier 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		supplier.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CurrentOrderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		result = isLinked
}
